02 / How I work

Strategy with dirty hands.

The useful answer is usually sitting between the customer conversation and the data model.

  1. 01

    Touch the raw material

    Read the transcripts. Open the search-terms report. Take the calls. Abstractions are earned after contact.

  2. 02

    Ship the smallest live loop

    A working v1 creates better information than a memo. Get the signal moving, then industrialise what proves useful.

  3. 03

    Build leverage that compounds

    Skills, tools and knowledge should make the next job cheaper. I design operating systems, not isolated automations.
